name: Cooley
source:
A delinquent angel who resides in room 201. She couldn't care less for the angelic teachings, and spends her time smoking.

[spoiler]Her real name is Akira Kiryuu. She was coerced into joining the 'family' after [url=https://vndb.org/c101159]Mother[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c83874]Sally[/url] hijacked her drug trafficking business, and threatened to report her to the police.
